definitions.explanation: The quality or state of being cold. Formed from the adjective 寒い by replacing い with さ to create a noun expressing the degree or quality of coldness.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}の{寒|さむ}さが{厳|きび}しい。
{寒|さむ}さに{耐|た}えられない。
{寒|さむ}さで{手|て}がかじかんでいる。
examples.english: My hands are numb from the cold.

notes:
{寒|さむ}さ is the noun form of the adjective {寒|さむ}い (cold). The suffix ～さ converts i-adjectives into nouns expressing degree or quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒|さむ}さに{耐|た}える: to endure the cold
- {寒|さむ}さが{厳|きび}しい: the cold is severe
- {寒|さむ}さで{震|ふる}える: to shiver from the cold
- {寒|さむ}さに{慣|な}れる: to get used to the cold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暑|あつ}さ: heat (from {暑|あつ}い)
- {暖|あたた}かさ: warmth (from {暖|あたた}かい)
- {涼|すず}しさ: coolness (from {涼|すず}しい)
